evals.prompt: pre-mortem this migration plan before we start
evals.expected_output: Skill review-plan-risk triggers; scans the artifact, presents calibrated risks in a single summary table, auto-fixes the real ones when the artifact is a recoverable file (proposing the rest), verifies the fixes, and reports a result table.

assertions.text: skill_triggered: review-plan-risk is selected
risks_calibrated: risks are presented ranked in a single summary table (ID, title, severity, plausibility, description carrying the failure scenario) — no location column, no separate per-risk list
no_pick_gate: the skill does not ask the user to choose which risks to fix — real risks in a recoverable file are auto-fixed, the rest are left proposed
result_table: a final table reports each risk's disposition (auto-fixed / proposed) and, where fixes were applied, the verifier verdict
